description: Emit a durable WorkerEvent when recordPatternOutcome's appendOutcomeOnMain returns a non-ok result instead of silently discarding it.

userStories.title: Log a durable event on non-ok pattern-outcome append
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a persistently diverged/detached/missing main to surface as a structured WorkerEvent in cam-worker-events.jsonl (not only transient stderr) so a failing pattern-outcome append is diagnosable after the fact.
acceptanceCriteria: A new WorkerEventKind 'pattern-outcome-append-failed' is added to the events.ts union with a typed detail interface { recordId: string; reason: 'not-found' | 'diverged' | 'detached-head' | 'missing-main' }, added to the WorkerEventDetail union (mirroring the SuggestionFiledEventDetail precedent). [oracle: grep -q "pattern-outcome-append-failed" src/supervisor/events.ts]

makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn threads the existing WorkerEventLogger in additively; on a non-ok appendOutcomeOnMain result it appends exactly one WorkerEvent of kind 'pattern-outcome-append-failed' carrying the recordId and reason. [oracle: grep -q "pattern-outcome-append-failed" src/supervisor/host.ts]
An ok:true appendOutcomeOnMain result produces NO failure event (no false positives), asserted by the new test. [oracle: bun test]

The returned recordPatternOutcome function keeps its (recordIds, status) => void signature and never throws on a failed append: the source-text guard (test/supervisor/loop.test.ts:4348-4361) and crash-survival test (loop.test.ts:4321-4339) stay green. [oracle: bun test]

appendOutcomeOnMain (src/commands/pattern-records.ts) is unchanged, including its existing printError on not-found. [oracle: file-assert git diff --stat main -- src/commands/pattern-records.ts shows no change]

The sidecar call site (src/commands/sidecar.ts:3235) passes the in-scope logEvent into makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn, mirroring the makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn(cwd, spawnFn, logEvent) wiring on the line above. [oracle: grep -q "makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn(cwd, logEvent)" src/commands/sidecar.ts]

A new test injects an in-memory logEvent plus a cwd/spawnFn that yields a non-ok appendOutcomeOnMain result and asserts exactly one failure event with the correct recordId and reason is logged, and asserts an ok result logs none. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Scope per CAM-336 spec (already decided, do not re-litigate). Files: src/supervisor/events.ts (add WorkerEventKind at the union ~line 114-152, add a detail interface near SuggestionFiledEventDetail ~line 479, add it to WorkerEventDetail union ~line 553); src/supervisor/host.ts (makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn at lines 228-236 -- add a WorkerEventLogger param additively and emit on the non-ok branch of appendOutcomeOnMain); src/commands/sidecar.ts:3235 (pass logEvent, already in scope and used one line up at :3228). appendOutcomeOnMain returns AppendOutcomeOnMainResult (src/commands/pattern-records.ts:397) whose ok:false shape is { ok:false, reason }; capture recordId from the loop variable in host.ts, not from the result (the error variant carries no recordId). Emit shape mirrors makeProductionFileSuggestionsFn (sidecar.ts:3172-3178): { ts: clock(), storyId: undefined, uuid: 'sidecar', kind, detail }. Gotchas: the returned fn's (recordIds, status) => void signature is pinned by a source-text guard test (loop.test.ts:4348-4361) -- change the FACTORY signature, never the returned closure's; crash-survival (loop.test.ts:4321-4339) must stay green (a thrown/failed append never breaks the loop). Do NOT create a second file writer -- reuse the logEvent built at host.ts:602 threaded through sidecar. Grep scripts/cam/patterns.md and scripts/cam/pattern-records.jsonl for 'event'/'supervisor'/'logEvent' before coding.
